_Last updated: 12 September 2026_

These terms govern your use of woodexinterior.com. By using the site you accept them. Commissions are governed by the written proposal and contract you sign with Woodex Interior, which take precedence over anything here.

## Use of this website

You may browse and share links to this site freely. You may not scrape, mirror or reproduce its content for commercial purposes, attempt to interfere with its operation, or use the contact forms to send unsolicited marketing.

## Content and intellectual property

All designs, drawings, renders, photographs and text on this site are the property of Woodex Interior or are used under licence from their owners and photographers. They may not be reproduced, distributed or used as the basis for other work without written permission. Client project images are published with the client's consent and may be withdrawn at their request.

## Proposals, quotations and prices

Information on this site — including indicative package prices — is for guidance only and does not constitute an offer. Scope, fees, allowances and timelines are confirmed only in a written proposal. Prices are quoted in Pakistani rupees, exclude applicable taxes unless stated, and are valid for the period stated on the proposal.

## Design work and joinery

Design fees cover the stages described in the proposal. Joinery and construction quotations are based on approved drawings; changes after approval are priced and confirmed in writing before work proceeds. Our joinery carries a five-year workmanship guarantee; hardware and appliances carry their manufacturers' warranties.

## Third-party links

The site may link to suppliers, manufacturers or social platforms. We are not responsible for the content or privacy practices of those sites.

## Liability

We make every effort to keep this site accurate and available, but it is provided "as is". To the fullest extent permitted by law we accept no liability for loss arising from reliance on its content or from its unavailability. Nothing in these terms limits liability that cannot be limited by law.

## Governing law

These terms are governed by the laws of Pakistan. Any dispute relating to the website will be subject to the exclusive jurisdiction of the courts of Lahore.
